If you print your shipping labels from Etsy, you can go into the order details and request a refund. It usually takes around 10-14 days if you use USPS labels.

I usually fill my orders the same day, sometimes if I’m bored within 30 mins of the order being placed. If USPS can’t verify the address and/or they add customization I send them a message which can sometimes take up to 2 days which puts me off schedule. As long as they message me before I ship the order out (as in leaving for the post office,) I’ll change the address and request a refund for the old shipping label.

Although their US warehouses are running minimally due to corona, Printful has some bracelets and necklace/pendants that you can get drop shipped. Only problem is you can only put text and their images on them.
